top_10_risks.title: Authentication Completely Disabled
top_10_risks.description: requireAuth/requireRole middleware was commented out. Every endpoint was accessible as admin without authentication.
top_10_risks.remediation: Re-enabled auth middleware, added centralized auth guard for all /api routes

top_10_risks.title: Hardcoded JWT Secrets with Weak Fallbacks
top_10_risks.description: JWT_SECRET and JWT_REFRESH_SECRET use trivially guessable fallback strings when env vars not set.
top_10_risks.remediation: Added .env.example with instructions to generate strong secrets. Fallbacks remain for backwards compat but are documented as MUST-CHANGE.

top_10_risks.title: Refresh Token Not Verified Cryptographically
top_10_risks.description: jwt.decode() was used instead of jwt.verify() on refresh endpoint — accepted unsigned/tampered tokens.
top_10_risks.remediation: Changed to jwt.verify() with proper error handling

top_10_risks.title: Gemini API Key Leaked to Client Bundle
top_10_risks.description: GEMINI_API_KEY was injected into client JS via Vite define, exposing it to all page visitors.
top_10_risks.remediation: Removed the define injection. Gemini calls should be server-side only.

top_10_risks.title: Division by Zero in Solar Calculation (sun_hours=0)
top_10_risks.description: calculateSolar divides by config.sun_hours without validation, producing Infinity when sun_hours=0.
top_10_risks.remediation: Added sun_hours > 0 guard in both engines with descriptive error message

top_10_risks.title: Amper Engine Day/Night Split Bug
top_10_risks.description: abpe_day_hours could exceed abpe_hours, causing day_wh + night_wh != total_wh (broken invariant).

top_10_risks.title: Amper Engine OFF_GRID Battery Oversizing
top_10_risks.description: OFF_GRID batteries sized for total_wh_after_losses (entire daily consumption), should be night load only.
top_10_risks.remediation: Changed to use profile.night_wh / loss_factor, consistent with solar_engine

top_10_risks.title: Stack Trace Leaked in Error Response
top_10_risks.description: amper-quote endpoint sent full err.stack to client, exposing file paths and internal structure.
top_10_risks.remediation: Removed stack from response, returns generic error in production

top_10_risks.title: Engineering Snapshot Loses Zero Values
top_10_risks.description: saveEngineeringSnapshot used || null which converts valid 0 values to null, losing data.

top_10_risks.title: CORS Allows All Origins in Non-Production
top_10_risks.description: CORS policy bypassed when NODE_ENV != production, allowing cross-origin attacks from any domain.
top_10_risks.remediation: Removed NODE_ENV bypass, CORS now uses strict CORS_ORIGINS env var

remaining_risks.title: Default Admin Password (admin123) in Source Code
remaining_risks.recommendation: Force password change on first login, or generate random password on seed and display once

remaining_risks.title: No CSRF Protection
remaining_risks.recommendation: Add csrf token middleware if cookie-based sessions are used alongside tokens

remaining_risks.title: No Multi-Tenancy Enforcement (IDOR)
remaining_risks.recommendation: Add company_id filtering to all data access queries

remaining_risks.title: Race Condition in Quote Approval Stock Deduction
remaining_risks.recommendation: Move status check inside transaction, add CHECK(stock_qty >= 0) constraint

remaining_risks.title: No User Management Endpoints
remaining_risks.recommendation: Add CRUD endpoints for users with password complexity requirements

remaining_risks.title: No Request Logging (morgan)
remaining_risks.recommendation: Add morgan or pino for HTTP request logging

remaining_risks.title: temp_correction Ambiguous Naming
remaining_risks.recommendation: Add validation temp_correction >= 1.0, rename to temp_capacity_factor

remaining_risks.title: Amper Engine Missing temp_correction in Battery Calc
remaining_risks.recommendation: Add temp_correction parameter to battery sizing, consistent with solar engine

remaining_risks.title: No Database Query Caching
remaining_risks.recommendation: Cache exchange rate and default margin (5-min TTL) to reduce DB reads

remaining_risks.title: Hardcoded Exchange Rate in Frontend (1480 IQD/USD)
